title: No set of type (2,5) with respect to lines in PG(3,9)
description: Computer-assisted proof that no point set of PG(3,9) meets every line in exactly 2 or exactly 5 points. SAT with cube splitting; every refutation has an LRAT proof checked by a formally verified checker. Code, cube lists, logs and replay scripts; the large formulas and proofs are in a separate Zenodo dataset named in the README. AI-generated under Lee Marshall's direction; not peer reviewed.
